_comment: antd / rustdesk-server-pro blue tokens -> ayaka pink ramp. Edit this file (or copy and pass --mapping) to switch themes. Keys are case-insensitive and matched as whole hex tokens.
_int_argb_comment: Decimal ARGB ints used by Flutter web's compiled Color(N) constants in static/web/main.dart.js. Source hex -> dest hex shown for sanity. Pink targets: FF5C8A=primary(stop 6), FF7099=stop 5, FF8DAE=stop 4, FFADC4=cyan-stand-in, FFCEDB=stop 2, C93F6C=stop 7 dark.
_web_custom_config_comment: Filled into static/web/index.html's {{CUSTOM_CONFIG}} placeholder. The Web Client V2 loader (js/dist/index.js -> Ko()) base64-decodes this then jsonDecode()s it, force-writing the 4 fields below into local settings on every load. Only these 4 keys are read; extras are ignored. // Values may be (a) a literal string (b) empty = no override (c) a ${LOCATION_*} marker that resolves in the BROWSER from window.location, so the web client adapts to whichever host serves it. Markers: ${LOCATION_HOSTNAME}, ${LOCATION_HOST}, ${LOCATION_ORIGIN}. When any value uses a marker, rebrand.py emits a tiny inline filler script (still pre-bakes if all values are literal). Env vars RUSTDESK_{RENDEZVOUS_SERVER,RELAY_SERVER,API_SERVER,RS_PUB_KEY} override per-field.
_session_bridge_comment: Mirror admin (umi/antd) <-> Web Client V2 login state via same-origin localStorage. The two upstream apps store the bearer token under different keys; this script syncs them on page load + on cross-tab 'storage' events so logging in on either propagates to the other. Sentinels are CI guards: rebrand.py greps the rebuilt output for these substrings, exits non-zero if upstream renames the key (mirror would silently no-op otherwise). Disable by setting enabled:false.
